title: Error 21610 after a recipient texts STOP, and the API cannot override it
symptoms: 21610 Attempt to send to unsubscribed recipient
Messages to one number fail while every other number succeeds
cause: Twilio processes STOP and the other opt-out keywords itself and blocks further messages from that sender or Messaging Service until the person texts START.
fix: Catch 21610, record the contact as opted out, and stop retrying. Only the recipient can lift it by texting START.
affected: Twilio Programmable Messaging default opt-out handling, checked October 2026
